items.title: Fractured Crystal Circle Slat DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Doors
items.description: An angular, shattered-glass style medallion built from irregular triangular facets breaks up an otherwise minimal slatted panel. The contrast between the rigid horizontal slats and the chaotic crystal core gives this design a modern, edgy feel suited to contemporary gates and loft-style partitions.

items.title: Bold Baroque Scroll Gate and Fence Design for Plasma and CNC
items.description: Make a powerful visual statement with this luxury heavy-duty entrance design. Merging classic Baroque scrollwork with bold, modern tribal contours, this vector file is meticulously prepared in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for flawless CNC plasma cutting, laser steel fabrication, and heavy MDF routing. The ultimate choice for custom metal gates, security doors, and centerpiece wall installations.
